inputs.text: Look at what happens when you abandon traditional order, personal responsibility, and stable governance for decades of socialist stagnation. The hardworking people on the ground in Cuba have been stripped of ownership and left in impoverishment, and now the nation is brought to the brink of a desperate political transition. Absolute state control destroys the chance for families to build generational security. And what is the inevitable result? A wealthy diaspora and foreign investors are waiting in the wings to swoop in and buy up property and businesses at bargain prices, destroying the cultural continuity of the homeland. Without a firm grounding in property ownership and true self-reliance, the local population is left entirely vulnerable to these outside economic forces. It is a stark warning of what happens when you let radical experiments erode traditional bonds and orderly rule.
